nodes.label: CLAUDE.md: Project guidance and working style
GLUE: Global Library Unified Exporter
nodes.rationale: Local-first web app for DJs; builds music collection from folders and DJ-app libraries; manages playlists, shows, sessions; finds duplicates; exports back to Rekordbox and Engine DJ

nodes.label: GLUE Stick: project theme
nodes.rationale: The headline is 'The GLUE between…'; always write GLUE in capitals in user-visible contexts

nodes.label: mco prefix: internal identifiers
nodes.rationale: Keep lowercase mco names for files, folders, settings (mco.json, mco-backup.json, IndexedDB mco, prefs mco.*); existing data depends on them

nodes.label: Spectral forensics (Speklone origin)
nodes.rationale: GLUE grew out of Speklone (spectral forensics: 'is this hi-res actually hi-res?'); becomes the per-track Inspector and 'Analyze a file' mode

nodes.label: TypeScript 6, Svelte 5, Vite 8 stack
nodes.rationale: Tech stack for GLUE website; npm run dev, npm run check, npm test, npx playwright test

nodes.label: src/core/: pure logic (no DOM)
nodes.rationale: Subdirectories: audio/, formats/, stems/, interop/ (DJ-library parsers), library/ (scan, tags, path matching, analysis summary)

nodes.label: src/store/: JSON store
nodes.rationale: Holds home, collection, merge of imports/scans, migrations

nodes.label: src/platform/: OS access layer
nodes.rationale: Folder access + IndexedDB handles; ADR 0007 states OS access only through this layer

nodes.label: src/lib/: state and orchestration
nodes.rationale: library.svelte.ts (library's state), lib/library/*.ts (methods by concern, ADR 0146), pool.ts (background analysis), app.svelte.ts (analyze-a-file), player, stems, route, view

nodes.label: src/ui/: components and renderers
nodes.rationale: Components in ui/library/ for the library; canvas renderers

nodes.label: cloud/: GLUE Cloud Worker
nodes.rationale: API, D1 migrations, signaling Durable Object; tests in tests/cloud.test.ts; deploy via .github/workflows/cloud.yml

nodes.label: home/: GLUE Home Tauri app
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app (ADR 0044); home/src-tauri Rust (tray, settings, incoming folder, autostart, gluehome://, local.rs); home/ui settings and hidden service pages

nodes.label: crates/glue-audio: native analysis engine
nodes.rationale: ADR 0147: line-for-line Rust port of src/core analysis with JavaScript's numbers; results held to TypeScript by tests/golden; cargo test and scripts/jsmath.mjs

nodes.label: crates/glue-store: library store in Rust
nodes.rationale: ADR 0152: held byte for byte to src/store/collection.ts by tests/golden/store

nodes.label: crates/glue-engine: library engine in Rust
nodes.rationale: ADR 0153: GLUE Home's library engine; local link's /rpc and stores, jobs and repair; glue-engine-test in e2e tests; e2e/engine-build.ts builds it

nodes.label: crates/glue-rtc: connections to other devices
nodes.rationale: ADR 0150: webrtc-rs speaking website's protocol (src/core/transfer.ts); cargo test against Edge; cargo build --release --example probe && node scripts/rtc-probe.mjs

nodes.label: graphify: code map (ADR 0127, 0128)
nodes.rationale: Maps code (tree-sitter: files, symbols, imports, calls, SQL migrations) and vault and help (ADRs, features, articles); order: vault first (how and why), graphify (find files), source last

nodes.label: Gluey: tours and help (ADR 0126)
nodes.rationale: When feature changes, update help article (src/help/*.md) and tour (src/core/guide/tours.ts pointing at data-guide attributes); tests/guide.test.ts checks they exist
